name: Lexical Uncoupling via Domain Shift
description: Shifts the problem from abstract acoustic physics to a concrete telecommunications framing (Antenna Alignment) while removing all contrived mathematical expressions (like the resonance matrix). This strips away the "competitive programming" feel and presents the problem as a natural domain-specific task, which often prevents LLMs from mapping it to their optimized graph-coloring templates, leading to naive backtracking and timeouts.
